notes.title: JUMP 1.2 is available on Steam!
notes.content:
The new build of JUMP is online! Now with full HTC Vive support! This update also includes - (6) New Maps with Steam Leaderboards:
[list]
     [*]San Francisco
     [*]Moscow
     [*]Hong Kong
     [*]Midnight
     [*]Daybreak
     [*]Dawn
[/list]

notes.title: JUMP 1.2 for the HTC Vive is coming soon!
notes.content: Hey Jumpers! Good news! JUMP 1.2 will be going live next month along side the Retail HTC Vive - using the latest StreamVR runtime. This new version of JUMP will include new maps and some cool new added features. We will send another announcement as soon as the new version goes live. Thank you - The E1 Team.

notes.title: Direct Mode now supported!
notes.content:
The recent SteamVR update has switched from using the Oculus 0.4.4 SDK to the latest 0.6.0.1 SDK.  What these means for JUMP is that Direct Mode now works much better.  There are some issues still, so check out the announcement for details.

http://steamcommunity.com/games/250820/announcements/detail/118571153701909043
